item.title: Catching Up With Oldham’s Karen Elson On A Night Out Up North
item.description: Back in her native Manchester for the first time since she closed Chanel’s Métiers D’Art show in the Northern Quarter, the Oldham-born supermodel Karen Elson discusses northern style, teen trips to the Arndale Centre, and the next generation of Brit girls.

item.title: They Were Raised By Millennials. Now, Today’s Tweens Are Driving The Beauty Industry
item.description: Gen Alpha may not be old enough to vote, drink or drive, but they are already reshaping the global beauty industry – and brands are starting to pay close attention. Georgia Day investigates.

item.title: On The Surface Things Looked “Perfect”. In Reality, Pelvic Pain Was Ruining My Life
item.description: On paper, Celia Munõz had it all: a mum to five children and the founder of a flourishing childrenswear business, La Coqueta. In reality, she was falling apart. In a personal essay for British Vogue, Munõz shares her years-long battle to get to the bottom of her agonising pelvic pain.

item.title: 25 Of Taylor Swift’s Best Ever Beauty Looks

item.description: “For me, it’s the influence of streetwear and a look I would consider quite ‘road’ – as a proud girl from South London,” says choreographer Kloe Dean of seeing her rehearsal uniform being emulated in east London pubs.
